stats.notes: No Common Data Set was found: cooper.edu/about/institutional-research/common-data-set returns 'Page not found' and the Office of Institutional Research page links only an institutional profile. Applicant, admit and enrolled counts are the profile's 'All first-year applicants entering 2025' (Applied 2219, Admitted 363, Enrolled 198; the profile prints selectivity 16.4% and yield 54.5%). Cooper's facts page quotes an 11% overall acceptance rate (4% Architecture, 8% Art, 16% Engineering) based on the total number of Common Applications submitted for fall 2025, which uses a different denominator. Undergraduate enrollment (834) and the nonresident count (97) are the profile's fall 2025 'Undergraduate Degree-Seeking' and 'U.S. Nonresident' rows. International applicant and admit counts, waitlist, early decision counts, GPA and admission factors are not published. The SAT/ACT submission shares (SAT 31%, ACT 8%) are from IPEDS fall 2024 enrolled first-time students (61 SAT, 16 ACT submitters) and the percentile ranges also come from IPEDS fall 2024; IPEDS lists no SAT total, so none is shown. Admission is by school (Architecture, Art, Engineering); the School of Engineering requires SAT/ACT while Architecture and Art are test-optional.

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.
